content: This step is where my "shadetree engineering" caught up with me.  I have a four-head conversion  and want the spools on the right side. Up to now, things have just worked - but the holder for the PTFE tubes isn't symmetrical so the cover would not fit. I had to trim it very slightly to get it in place.  Why right side? Because that's where my dryer is, AND you can't use the extended poop chute with spoolholders on the left.

I advise reading through Steps 81-85 before proceeding. I decided to connect the Hinge-base to the hinge-cover with the M3x25 and Spring 15x5 first.

Then I attached the hinges and cover using the 3X12sT to the top of the printer in step 82. Pre-threadhing helps just dont thread it all the way. Also it really helps to use the T10 Allen wrench here after you have started the screw to tighten it down as you will need to hold the top of the top of the hinge a bit to keep it from twisting and keep it aligned when tightening.

This way you have the entire hinge assembly attached to the cover and you just lay it on the printer to install.

Again this is the way I decided to do it, your mileage may vary.
